source_snapshot.items: M.2 FIO 70% read/30% write QD1 512B one job
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL proposes 70/30 mix but does not reconcile 100% writes.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: Requires randrw+rwmixread=70, disposable M.2, authorization and limits.

old_problem: The 70% read/30% write M.2 objective conflicts with a literal 100%-write job; namespace, destructive extent, duration and thresholds are absent.
disposition_reason: ED-04 cannot transform `rw=randwrite` into a mixed workload because the change alters read coverage, write amplification and endurance risk. The M.2 source owner must approve the authoritative semantic before safe project binding.
decision_basis: Directly read Compatibility row6 all18 XLSX cells and history2622.
Preserved M.2 identity, 70%-read/30%-write coverage and the literal all-write conflict.
Did not infer a namespace or execute fio.

test_case.test_name: M.2 FIO QD1 512B 70% read/30% write validation pending workload authority
test_case.purpose: Measure M.2 read/write IOPS, bandwidth and latency for the approved 70/30 random workload on one disposable namespace.
required_package: Source-owner approval of randrw+rwmixread=70 instead of randwrite
Pinned fio binary/version and approved job hash
Disposable non-OS M.2 namespace with serial/controller/BDF mapping, extent and mode
Authorized runtime and M.2-specific read/write/latency thresholds
Data-loss approval, NVMe health/thermal/power aborts and recovery owner
test_case.test_command: Do not run the all-write source job. After semantics are approved, map controller, namespace, serial and BDF; reject OS/boot/mounted/RAID/open targets; capture NVMe health; run the bounded QD1 512B one-job profile once; preserve fio JSON plus NVMe telemetry and leave namespace recreation to the owner.
test_case.expected_result: The authorized 70%-read mix runs only on the designated M.2 namespace, meets approved metrics and adds no media, controller or platform error.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires approved mixed semantics, exact namespace and thresholds. A 100%-write result does not test 70% read coverage.
safety_gate: Block until the randwrite conflict and data loss are approved.
Verify namespace serial/controller/BDF and exclude OS, mount, RAID and holders.
Bound extent/time and avoid whole-device inference.
Abort on NVMe critical warning, media error or thermal/power limit; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Pre/post NVMe SMART/error log and kernel log
fio JSON with actual I/O mix and metrics
test_case.recovery: On namespace remap, NVMe warning or unintended all-write behavior, stop fio, preserve controller/namespace/error-log evidence, keep the namespace detached from production mounts, and require the M.2 owner to assess wear/data impact before approved format or reuse.

blocked.reason: The M.2 source/project owners can provide semantics and safe bindings.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: After semantic decision, bind namespace, extent, runtime, limits and recovery.
pending.execution_status: ENGINEERING DECISION RETAINED; DESTRUCTIVE FIO NOT EXECUTED
pending.owner: M.2 testcase owner and project storage owner.
pending.unlock_condition: Authorize mixed randrw semantics or revise coverage, then provide the destructive namespace profile.

project_authority: Workload correction and device-specific limits require project authority.
